SideSpeed 0.8.5 fixes Back after measure, and ships Arabic in the Companion.

## What's fixed
- **Back after measure.** After you measure an app, Back from Home leaves SideSpeed and returns to the TV's home screen (Google TV and Fire TV).
- **Arabic in the Companion.** The Companion now ships Arabic. A few lines still show in English.

## Languages
- **TV app:** English and Arabic. About 4% of the Arabic (10 strings) is not translated yet and shows in English.
- **Companion:** English and Arabic. About 15% of the Arabic (23 strings) is not translated yet and shows in English.

To help translate, see [sidespeed.app/translate](https://sidespeed.app/translate/).

**After updating:** start the helper again (on Google TV, open SideSpeed; on Fire TV, use the Companion).

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.8.5.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.5.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.5-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.5-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.5-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
